"""Notification engine: WhatsApp first, SMS fallback, every attempt logged (blueprint Epic 4 + DoD).

Providers are simulated in demo mode. A real provider (Meta Cloud API / Wati, local SMS gateway)
implements the same `send(phone, body) -> message id` and raises on failure.
"""
import logging
import uuid

from django.conf import settings
from django.utils import timezone

from .models import Notification

log = logging.getLogger("lms")


class ProviderError(Exception):
    pass


class SimulatedWhatsApp:
    channel = "whatsapp"

    def send(self, phone, body):
        # For the demo, numbers listed here behave like a parent without WhatsApp.
        if phone in getattr(settings, "SIMULATE_WHATSAPP_FAILURE", ()):
            raise ProviderError("recipient is not on WhatsApp")
        return "wa-" + uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]


class SimulatedSMS:
    channel = "sms"

    def send(self, phone, body):
        return "sms-" + uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]


PROVIDERS = [SimulatedWhatsApp(), SimulatedSMS()]


def send(student, recipient, role, template, body, lesson=None):
    """Deliver one message to a parent or teacher. Returns the Notification that succeeded (or the last one)."""
    phone = recipient.phone_number
    today = timezone.localdate()
    sent_today = Notification.objects.filter(recipient_phone=phone, sent_at__date=today,
                                             status__in=("sent", "delivered")).count()
    common = dict(student=student, recipient=recipient, recipient_phone=phone, recipient_role=role,
                  template_type=template, body=body, lesson=lesson)
    if role == "parent" and sent_today >= settings.MAX_MESSAGES_PER_PARENT_PER_DAY:
        log.warning("daily message limit reached for %s", phone)
        return Notification.objects.create(channel="whatsapp", status="skipped", error="daily limit reached", **common)
    last = None
    for provider in PROVIDERS:
        try:
            msg_id = provider.send(phone, body)
            return Notification.objects.create(channel=provider.channel, status="delivered",
                                               provider_msg_id=msg_id, **common)
        except ProviderError as e:
            log.warning("%s to %s failed: %s", provider.channel, phone, e)
            last = Notification.objects.create(channel=provider.channel, status="failed", error=str(e)[:200], **common)
    return last


def pronoun(student):
    return "she" if student.gender == "female" else "he"


def absence_alert(student, parent, subject, school_class, lesson):
    body = (f"Dear Parent, {student.full_name} was marked absent today in {subject.name} ({school_class}). "
            f"Missed lecture: \"{lesson.topic} {lesson.title}\". Please ensure {pronoun(student)} completes the "
            f"digital backup lecture and quiz before the next class.")
    return send(student, parent, "parent", "absence_alert", body, lesson)


def clearance_granted(student, parent, teachers, lesson, score):
    send(student, parent, "parent", "clearance_granted",
         f"Dear Parent, {student.full_name} has completed the missed lecture \"{lesson.topic} {lesson.title}\" and "
         f"passed the assessment ({score}/{settings.QUIZ_SIZE}). {pronoun(student).capitalize()} is cleared for class entry.",
         lesson)
    for t in teachers:
        send(student, t, "teacher", "clearance_granted",
             f"{student.full_name} ({student.student.roll_number}) completed \"{lesson.topic} {lesson.title}\" and scored "
             f"{score}/{settings.QUIZ_SIZE}. Cleared for class entry.", lesson)


def clearance_override(student, parent, lesson):
    send(student, parent, "parent", "clearance_override",
         f"Dear Parent, {student.full_name} has been cleared for class entry by the class teacher "
         f"for the missed lecture \"{lesson.topic} {lesson.title}\".", lesson)

# F21: Parent progress view and weekly summary

Status: Draft for sign-off · Owner: Muhammad Noor Khan · Last updated: 2026-09-30

Plan: [implementation plan, F21](../implementation-plan-subjects-languages-admin-parent.md#f21-parent-progress-view) · Decisions: D6 (free channels only), plan decision 4 (summary on Sunday 18:00 PKT)

## Problem

A parent today sees only whether their child has a pending clearance, the last 7 days of attendance, and the college's messages. They can't tell whether the child is keeping up: how many topics are done in each subject, how the quizzes went, or how often the child is absent. To find out, they have to call the college. Parents also get nothing when things are going well, so the app only ever brings bad news.

## Users and access rules

| Role | What they can do | What they must never see or do |
|---|---|---|
| Parent | See progress for each of **their own** children: subjects, topics, quiz scores, attendance rate, time taken to clear; read the weekly summary; turn the weekly summary on or off | Any other child's data, even with a valid id; quiz questions or answers; teacher notes |
| Student | No change | — |
| Teacher | No change in F21 | — |
| College admin | No change in F21 | — |

The parent view is read-only apart from the summary on/off switch.

## Screens

**Phone (360 px):**
- **Parent home, one card per child:**
  - Name, class and roll number, with a status line: *Up to date* (green) or *1 missed lecture to clear* (amber).
  - Three numbers in a row:
    - **attendance** over the last 30 days (for example 92%)
    - **topics done** across subjects (for example 3 of 3)
    - **average quiz score** (for example 4.3/5)
  - One progress bar per subject, with "Coming soon" subjects greyed; tapping a subject opens the child's subject detail.
  - The existing pending-clearance lines and the recent attendance strip.
  - *Last active*, for example "Last studied today at 4:10 pm", or "No lessons started yet".
- **Child subject detail (new):**
  - Topics grouped by unit, each with a plain status: *Not started*, *Listening (45% heard)*, *Quiz ready*, *Passed 4/5* or *Missed, now cleared*.
  - A short note at the top explains the 4/5 pass mark.
  - Read-only: no buttons that change anything.
- **Messages:** weekly summaries appear in the same list as the college's alerts, marked **In app**, not with WhatsApp ticks.
- **Weekly summary switch:** at the bottom of the parent home: "Weekly summary every Sunday · On/Off".
- **Empty and error states:**
  - a child with no subjects: "The college hasn't added subjects yet"
  - no attendance yet: "No attendance recorded yet" instead of 0%
  - loading and offline use the existing cards

**Desktop (1200 px):** children's cards side by side (two columns). The child detail shows units on the left and topics on the right.

**Offline:** no offline mode yet (F4). The existing "You are offline" card with Try again; no blank screens.

## API and data changes

| Method and path | Who can call it | Request | Response | Errors |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `GET /api/parent/home` (changed) | Parent | — | Adds per child: `summary {attendanceRate30d, attendanceDays30d, topicsDone, topicsTotal, avgScore, medianDaysToClear, lastActive}` and `subjects [{code, name, status, done, total, avgScore}]`; adds `weeklySummary: true/false` for the parent | — |
| `GET /api/parent/children/<student_id>/subjects/<code>` (new) | Parent, **only their own child**, only subjects taught to that child's class | — | `{child, subject, units: [{number, title, status, topics: [{topic, title, status, heardShare, best, missed, cleared}]}]}` | 404 for another parent's child, an unknown child, or a subject not taught to the class (never 403, so ids are not confirmed) |
| `POST /api/parent/settings` (new) | Parent | `{weeklySummary: bool}` | `{weeklySummary}` | 400 if not a boolean |

**Numbers, defined:**
- **Attendance rate:** (present + late) ÷ all attendance records in the last 30 days, across subjects. `null` when there are none.

- **Median days to clear:** over clearances cleared in the last 90 days, from the absence date to the clearance date.
- **Last active:** the latest progress update or quiz submission.

  - Writes one inbox message per parent per child, type `weekly_summary`, covering Monday to Sunday.
  - Skips parents who turned the summary off, and logs "skipped: opted out".
  - Idempotent: running twice in one week sends nothing new.

6. Given an absence on Monday cleared on Tuesday, then the median days to clear is 1.

class ParentProgress(ApiBase):
    """F21: parent progress view and weekly summary."""

    def setUp(self):
        from .models import Subject
        self.ali = User.objects.get(phone_number=ALI)
        self.physics = Subject.objects.get(code="phy11")
        self.teacher = User.objects.get(phone_number=A_TEACHER)

    def attend(self, days_ago, status, lesson=LESSON):
        from .models import Attendance
        return Attendance.objects.create(school_class=self.ali.student.school_class, student=self.ali,
                                         subject=self.physics, date=timezone.localdate() - timedelta(days=days_ago),
                                         status=status, lesson_id=lesson, marked_by=self.teacher)

    def passed(self, lesson, best):
        LessonProgress.objects.update_or_create(student=self.ali, lesson_id=lesson,
                                                defaults={"unlocked": True, "passed": True, "best_score": best})

    def child(self, token=None):
        _, home = self.call("get", "parent/home", token=token or self.login(ALI_PARENT))
        return home["children"][0]

    # 1: topic statuses and scores in the child's subject detail
    def test_parent_sees_topic_status_and_score(self):
        self.passed("u1-estimation", 4)
        LessonProgress.objects.create(student=self.ali, lesson_id="u1-dimensions", heard_secs=list(range(50)))
        status, d = self.call("get", f"parent/children/{self.ali.id}/subjects/phy11", token=self.login(ALI_PARENT))
        self.assertEqual(status, 200)
        topics = {t["topic"]: t for t in d["units"][0]["topics"]}
        self.assertEqual((topics["1.1"]["status"], topics["1.1"]["best"]), ("passed", 4))
        self.assertEqual(topics["1.2"]["status"], "not_started")
        self.assertEqual(topics["1.3"]["status"], "listening")
        self.assertNotIn("quiz", json.dumps(d).lower().replace("quiz_ready", ""))  # no quiz content leaks

    # 2, 7: only their own child, only subjects of the child's class
    def test_parent_cannot_see_other_child_or_untaught_subject(self):
        t = self.login(ALI_PARENT)
        bilal = User.objects.get(phone_number=BILAL)
        self.assertEqual(self.call("get", f"parent/children/{bilal.id}/subjects/phy11", token=t)[0], 404)
        self.assertEqual(self.call("get", "parent/children/not-a-uuid/subjects/phy11", token=t)[0], 404)
        self.assertEqual(self.call("get", f"parent/children/{self.ali.id}/subjects/math11", token=t)[0], 404)

    # 3: other roles are refused
    def test_parent_endpoints_refuse_other_roles(self):
        for phone in (ALI, A_TEACHER):
            t = self.login(phone)
            self.assertEqual(self.call("get", f"parent/children/{self.ali.id}/subjects/phy11", token=t)[0], 403)
            self.assertEqual(self.call("post", "parent/settings", {"weeklySummary": False}, token=t)[0], 403)

    # 4: attendance rate over 30 days, null when nothing recorded
    def test_attendance_rate(self):
        self.assertIsNone(self.child()["summary"]["attendanceRate30d"])
        for d in range(1, 6):
            self.attend(d, "present")
        self.attend(6, "absent")
        self.attend(40, "absent")  # outside the 30-day window
        s = self.child()["summary"]
        self.assertEqual((s["attendanceRate30d"], s["attendanceClasses30d"]), (83, {"present": 5, "total": 6}))

    # 5: topics done and average score
    def test_topics_done_and_average_score(self):
        self.passed("u1-estimation", 4)
        self.passed("u1-derived-units", 5)
        c = self.child()
        self.assertEqual((c["summary"]["topicsDone"], c["summary"]["topicsTotal"], c["summary"]["avgScore"]), (2, 3, 4.5))
        phy = next(x for x in c["subjects"] if x["code"] == "phy11")
        self.assertEqual((phy["done"], phy["total"], phy["avgScore"]), (2, 3, 4.5))

    # 6: median days from absence to clearance
    def test_median_days_to_clear(self):
        from .models import Clearance
        att = self.attend(3, "absent")
        Clearance.objects.create(student=self.ali, lesson_id=LESSON, attendance=att, status="cleared", cleared_by="quiz",
                                 cleared_at=timezone.now() - timedelta(days=2))
        self.assertEqual(self.child()["summary"]["medianDaysToClear"], 1)

    def summaries(self):
        return Notification.objects.filter(template_type="weekly_summary")

    # 8: one inbox message per parent per child, idempotent
    def test_weekly_summary_once_per_week(self):
        self.attend(1, "present")
        self.passed("u1-estimation", 4)
        call_command("send_weekly_summaries", stdout=open(os.devnull, "w"))
        n = self.summaries().count()
        self.assertEqual(n, User.objects.filter(role=User.PARENT).count())
        mine = self.summaries().get(recipient__phone_number=ALI_PARENT)
        self.assertEqual((mine.channel, mine.status), ("inbox", "delivered"))
        self.assertIn("Ali", mine.body)
        self.assertIn("Physics 1 of 3 topics", mine.body)
        call_command("send_weekly_summaries", stdout=open(os.devnull, "w"))
        self.assertEqual(self.summaries().count(), n)

    # 9: parents who turned it off get nothing
    def test_weekly_summary_opt_out(self):
        t = self.login(ALI_PARENT)
        self.assertEqual(self.call("post", "parent/settings", {"weeklySummary": "no"}, token=t)[0], 400)
        status, d = self.call("post", "parent/settings", {"weeklySummary": False}, token=t)
        self.assertEqual((status, d["weeklySummary"]), (200, False))
        self.assertFalse(self.call("get", "parent/home", token=t)[1]["weeklySummary"])
        call_command("send_weekly_summaries", stdout=open(os.devnull, "w"))
        self.assertFalse(self.summaries().filter(recipient__phone_number=ALI_PARENT).exists())

    # 10, 11: the inbox is exempt from the daily limit and shows as in-app
    @override_settings(MAX_MESSAGES_PER_PARENT_PER_DAY=0)
    def test_weekly_summary_ignores_daily_limit_and_is_in_app(self):
        call_command("send_weekly_summaries", stdout=open(os.devnull, "w"))
        self.assertTrue(self.summaries().filter(recipient__phone_number=ALI_PARENT, status="delivered").exists())
        _, msgs = self.call("get", "messages", token=self.login(ALI_PARENT))
        self.assertEqual([m["channel"] for m in msgs if m["type"] == "weekly_summary"], ["inbox"])


class Frontend(TestCase):

"""Send each parent a weekly progress summary per child (F21), as a free in-app message (decision D6).

Schedule it for Sunday 18:00 Pakistan time:
  Windows: Task Scheduler -> "python manage.py send_weekly_summaries" in the backend folder.
  Linux:   0 18 * * 0  cd /path/to/backend && python manage.py send_weekly_summaries
Running it again in the same week sends nothing new. Parents who turned the summary off are skipped.
"""
from datetime import date, timedelta

from django.core.management.base import BaseCommand, CommandError
from django.utils import timezone

from lms import notify
from lms.api import child_progress
from lms.models import Attendance, Clearance, Notification, User


def week_bounds(end=None):
    """Monday to Sunday of the week ending on `end` (default: the most recent Sunday, or today if Sunday)."""
    today = timezone.localdate()
    end = end or today - timedelta(days=(today.weekday() + 1) % 7)
    return end - timedelta(days=6), end


def summary_text(student, start, end):
    att = Attendance.objects.filter(student=student, date__range=(start, end))
    total = att.count()
    present = att.filter(status__in=(Attendance.PRESENT, Attendance.LATE)).count()
    absences = Clearance.objects.filter(student=student, attendance__date__range=(start, end))
    cleared = absences.filter(status=Clearance.CLEARED).count()
    data = child_progress(student)
    parts = [f"Weekly summary, {start:%a %d %b} to {end:%a %d %b}. {student.full_name}: "
             + (f"present in {present} of {total} classes." if total else "no classes recorded this week.")]
    if absences.exists():
        n = absences.count()
        parts.append(f"{n} missed lecture{'s' if n > 1 else ''}, {cleared} cleared.")
    live = [s for s in data["subjects"] if s["status"] == "live"]
    if live:
        parts.append("; ".join(f"{s['name']} {s['done']} of {s['total']} topics"
                               + (f", average quiz {s['avgScore']:g}/5" if s["avgScore"] is not None else "")
                               for s in live) + ".")
    soon = [s["name"] for s in data["subjects"] if s["status"] != "live"]
    if soon:
        parts.append(", ".join(soon) + ": coming soon.")
    return " ".join(parts)


class Command(BaseCommand):
    help = "Send the weekly progress summary to every parent who has it switched on."

    def add_arguments(self, parser):
        parser.add_argument("--week-ending", help="YYYY-MM-DD, a Sunday (default: the most recent Sunday)")
        parser.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true", help="print the messages without saving them")

    def handle(self, week_ending=None, dry_run=False, **opts):
        try:
            end = date.fromisoformat(week_ending) if week_ending else None
        except ValueError:
            raise CommandError("--week-ending must be YYYY-MM-DD")
        start, end = week_bounds(end)
        key = f"week:{end.isoformat()}"  # makes the command idempotent per parent, child and week
        sent = skipped = 0
        for parent in User.objects.filter(role=User.PARENT, is_active=True).prefetch_related("children__user"):
            for profile in parent.children.all():
                if not profile.user.is_active:
                    continue
                if not parent.weekly_summary:
                    skipped += 1
                    continue
                if Notification.objects.filter(recipient=parent, student=profile.user, template_type="weekly_summary",
                                               provider_msg_id=key).exists():
                    continue
                body = summary_text(profile.user, start, end)
                if dry_run:
                    self.stdout.write(body)
                    continue
                n = notify.inbox(profile.user, parent, "parent", "weekly_summary", body)
                n.provider_msg_id = key
                n.save(update_fields=["provider_msg_id"])
                sent += 1
        self.stdout.write(self.style.SUCCESS(f"Week {start} to {end}: {sent} sent, {skipped} skipped (opted out)."))

input.content:
# F22: College admin console

Status: Signed off 2026-10-01 (instruction "continue with the whole development") · Owner: Muhammad Noor Khan · Last updated: 2026-10-01

Plan: [implementation plan, F22](../implementation-plan-subjects-languages-admin-parent.md#f22-college-admin-console-registering-teachers-students-and-admins) · Includes F5 (roster import) · Decisions: one role per phone number; free sign-in (D6)

## Problem

Today every teacher, student and parent is typed into the Django admin panel by the EduSaas team. That panel shows every college's data to whoever signs in, so it cannot be handed to a college. Colleges need to register and manage their own people, import a whole class from a spreadsheet, and approve teachers' "Add subject" requests, without ever seeing another college.

## Users and access rules

| Role | What they can do | What they must never see or do |
|---|---|---|
| College admin | Sign in to the app; add, edit, suspend and reactivate teachers, students and parents of **their college**; create classes; assign teachers to classes and subjects; import a roster from CSV; approve or decline subject requests; read their college's activity log | Anything belonging to another college (lists, ids, imports, requests, audit); the Django admin panel |
| EduSaas team (superuser) | Create a college and its first admin (`create_college` command or the Django admin panel) | — |
| Teacher, student, parent | No change. Calling any admin endpoint returns 403 | — |

All admin queries are filtered by the admin's college on the server. An id from another college returns 404, never 403, so ids are not confirmed.

## Screens

**Phone (360 px)**, bottom bar: Home, People, Classes, Import.
- **Home:**
  - counts (teachers, students, parents, classes)
  - **Subject requests** waiting, with Approve and Decline (the Decline note is shown to the teacher)
  - the last 10 activity entries, with a link to the full log
- **People:**
  - tabs for Teachers, Students and Parents
  - a search box (name, phone or roll number)
  - each row shows name, phone, class or roll, and a Suspended badge
  - **Add** opens a form in a dialog; tapping a row opens the same form to edit or suspend
- **Classes:**
  - each class with its student count and teaching assignments
  - **New class**
  - **Assign teacher**, which picks a teacher and a subject of the class's grade
  - remove an assignment
- **Import:**
  - choose Students or Teachers, download the CSV template, paste or upload the file
  - **Check file** shows a row-by-row report (green or red with the reason)
  - **Import** saves everything or nothing
- **Empty, loading and error states** as in the rest of the app.

**Desktop (1200 px):** side menu; People as a table; the dialog centred.

## API and data changes

All endpoints are under `/api/admin/` and need the `college_admin` role. Every query is limited to `request.user.college`.

| Method and path | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `GET admin/overview` | Counts, pending subject requests, recent activity |
| `GET, POST admin/classes` | List classes; create one (`grade`, `stream`, `section`, `gender`, `academicYear`) |
| `GET, POST admin/people?role=&q=` | List or search; add a teacher, student or parent |
| `POST admin/people/<id>` | Edit name, phone, class or roll; suspend or reactivate (`active`, with a `reason` when suspending) |
| `GET, POST admin/assignments`, `DELETE admin/assignments/<id>` | Teaching assignments |
| `GET admin/subject-requests`, `POST admin/subject-requests/<id>/decide` | `{approve, note}`; uses the F20 rule (same college only) |
| `POST admin/imports` | `{kind: "students"/"teachers", csv}`: validate only, returns a report and an import id |
| `POST admin/imports/<id>/commit` | Save a validated import, all or nothing |
| `GET admin/audit` | The college's activity log, newest first |

Model and migration changes:
- **`AuditLog`:** college, actor, action, object type, object id, summary, time. Phone numbers in summaries are masked (`+92 3** ***0001`).
- **`ImportBatch`:** college, uploaded by, kind, rows (validated data), errors, status (`checked`/`committed`), counts.
- **Sign-in:** `college_admin` accounts sign in to the app with the same code flow. Superusers still use `/admin`.
- **Django admin:** the panel is for superusers only. College admin accounts are never staff.
- **New command `create_college "<name>" --admin-phone 03… --admin-name "…"`.**

**Roster CSV (students):** `class_grade, class_stream, class_section, roll_number, student_name, student_gender, student_phone, parent_name, parent_phone`. Checks:
- phones are valid and normalised, and not used by another college or another role
- the class exists in this college
- roll numbers are unique in the class, both in the file and in the database
- gender matches the class
- a parent with several children appears once, matched by phone

**Teacher CSV:** `teacher_name, teacher_phone, teacher_gender, subject, class_grade, class_stream, class_section` (subject by code or name). It creates the teacher if new, then the teaching assignment.

## Acceptance criteria

1. Given an admin of College A, when they list people, classes, requests or the audit log, then only College A records are returned.
2. Given an admin of College A, when they edit, suspend, assign or approve using a College B id, then the server returns 404 and nothing changes.
3. Given a teacher, student or parent token, when they call any `/api/admin/` endpoint, then the server returns 403.
4. Given a new teacher added by the admin, when they request a sign-in code, then they can sign in and see only their assigned classes.
5. Given a suspended student, when they request a code, then they are refused with the suspended message; when reactivated, they can sign in again.
6. Given a phone number already used by any account, when the admin adds a person with it, then the server returns 409.
7. Given a student CSV with a duplicate roll number, an unknown class and a bad phone, then the check reports each row with its reason, and commit is refused until a clean file is checked.

# F22: College admin console

Status: Signed off 2026-10-01 (instruction "continue with the whole development") · Owner: Muhammad Noor Khan · Last updated: 2026-10-01

## Problem

Today every teacher, student and parent is typed into the Django admin panel by the EduSaas team. That panel shows every college's data to whoever signs in, so it cannot be handed to a college. Colleges need to register and manage their own people, import a whole class from a spreadsheet, and approve teachers' "Add subject" requests, without ever seeing another college.

## Users and access rules

| Role | What they can do | What they must never see or do |
|---|---|---|
| College admin | Sign in to the app; add, edit, suspend and reactivate teachers, students and parents of **their college**; create classes; assign teachers to classes and subjects; import a roster from CSV; approve or decline subject requests; read their college's activity log | Anything belonging to another college (lists, ids, imports, requests, audit); the Django admin panel |
| EduSaas team (superuser) | Create a college and its first admin (`create_college` command or the Django admin panel) | — |
| Teacher, student, parent | No change. Calling any admin endpoint returns 403 | — |

All admin queries are filtered by the admin's college on the server. An id from another college returns 404, never 403, so ids are not confirmed.

## Screens

**Phone (360 px)**, bottom bar: Home, People, Classes, Import.
- **Home:**
  - counts (teachers, students, parents, classes)
  - **Subject requests** waiting, with Approve and Decline (the Decline note is shown to the teacher)
  - the last 10 activity entries, with a link to the full log
- **People:**
  - tabs for Teachers, Students and Parents
  - a search box (name, phone or roll number)
  - each row shows name, phone, class or roll, and a Suspended badge
  - **Add** opens a form in a dialog; tapping a row opens the same form to edit or suspend
- **Classes:**
  - each class with its student count and teaching assignments
  - **New class**
  - **Assign teacher**, which picks a teacher and a subject of the class's grade
  - remove an assignment
- **Import:**
  - choose Students or Teachers, download the CSV template, paste or upload the file
  - **Check file** shows a row-by-row report (green or red with the reason)
  - **Import** saves everything or nothing
- **Empty, loading and error states** as in the rest of the app.

**Desktop (1200 px):** side menu; People as a table; the dialog centred.

## API and data changes

All endpoints are under `/api/admin/` and need the `college_admin` role. Every query is limited to `request.user.college`.

| Method and path | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `GET admin/overview` | Counts, pending subject requests, recent activity |
| `GET, POST admin/classes` | List classes; create one (`grade`, `stream`, `section`, `gender`, `academicYear`) |
| `GET, POST admin/people?role=&q=` | List or search; add a teacher, student or parent |
| `POST admin/people/<id>` | Edit name, phone, class or roll; suspend or reactivate (`active`, with a `reason` when suspending) |
| `GET, POST admin/assignments`, `DELETE admin/assignments/<id>` | Teaching assignments |
| `GET admin/subject-requests`, `POST admin/subject-requests/<id>/decide` | `{approve, note}`; uses the F20 rule (same college only) |
| `POST admin/imports` | `{kind: "students"/"teachers", csv}`: validate only, returns a report and an import id |
| `POST admin/imports/<id>/commit` | Save a validated import, all or nothing |
| `GET admin/audit` | The college's activity log, newest first |

- **`AuditLog`:** college, actor, action, object type, object id, summary, time. Phone numbers in summaries are masked (`+92 3** ***0001`).
- **`ImportBatch`:** college, uploaded by, kind, rows (validated data), errors, status (`checked`/`committed`), counts.
- **Sign-in:** `college_admin` accounts sign in to the app with the same code flow. Superusers still use `/admin`.
- **Django admin:** the panel is for superusers only. College admin accounts are never staff.
- **New command `create_college "<name>" --admin-phone 03… --admin-name "…"`.**

**Roster CSV (students):** `class_grade, class_stream, class_section, roll_number, student_name, student_gender, student_phone, parent_name, parent_phone`. Checks:
- phones are valid and normalised, and not used by another college or another role
- the class exists in this college
- roll numbers are unique in the class, both in the file and in the database
- gender matches the class
- a parent with several children appears once, matched by phone

**Teacher CSV:** `teacher_name, teacher_phone, teacher_gender, subject, class_grade, class_stream, class_section` (subject by code or name). It creates the teacher if new, then the teaching assignment.

2. Given an admin of College A, when they edit, suspend, assign or approve using a College B id, then the server returns 404 and nothing changes.

- Activation code and PIN sign-in (F2), billing (F13), a principal dashboard (F10).

- **Phone numbers reused across colleges.** A parent may have children at two colleges. For now one number belongs to one account and one college; the import reports the clash.

COLLEGE_ADMIN = "+923994440001"   # demo college admin (Margalla Heights)
OTHER_ADMIN = "+923994449001"     # admin of a second college, created in the tests

STUDENT_CSV = """class_grade,class_stream,class_section,roll_number,student_name,student_gender,student_phone,parent_name,parent_phone
11th,Pre-Medical,A,11A-21,Imran Ali,male,03992221021,Mr. Ali Khan,03993331021
11th,Pre-Medical,A,11A-22,Faisal Ali,male,03992221022,Mr. Ali Khan,03993331021
"""


class CollegeAdminConsole(ApiBase):
    """F22: the college admin registers and manages their own college, and nothing else."""

    @classmethod
    def setUpTestData(cls):
        super().setUpTestData()
        from .models import College, SchoolClass, StudentProfile
        other = College.objects.create(name="Other College")
        User.objects.create_user(OTHER_ADMIN, "Other Admin", User.COLLEGE_ADMIN, college=other, gender="male")
        cls.other_class = SchoolClass.objects.create(college=other, grade="11th", stream="Pre-Medical", section="Z",
                                                     academic_year="2026-2027", gender="male")
        parent = User.objects.create_user("+923993339901", "Other Parent", User.PARENT, college=other, gender="male")
        cls.other_student = User.objects.create_user("+923992229902", "Other Student", User.STUDENT, college=other,
                                                     gender="male")
        StudentProfile.objects.create(user=cls.other_student, school_class=cls.other_class, roll_number="Z-01",
                                      parent=parent)

    def admin(self):
        return self.login(COLLEGE_ADMIN)

    def my_class_id(self, t):
        _, classes = self.call("get", "admin/classes", token=t)
        return next(c["id"] for c in classes if c["name"] == "11th Pre-Medical A")

    # 1: lists are limited to the admin's college
    def test_lists_only_own_college(self):
        t = self.admin()
        for role in ("student", "teacher", "parent"):
            _, rows = self.call("get", f"admin/people?role={role}", token=t)
            self.assertTrue(rows)
            self.assertNotIn("Other", " ".join(r["name"] for r in rows))
        _, classes = self.call("get", "admin/classes", token=t)
        self.assertNotIn(str(self.other_class.id), [c["id"] for c in classes])
        _, people = self.call("get", "admin/people?role=student&q=Other", token=t)
        self.assertEqual(people, [])

    # 2: another college's ids are 404 and change nothing
    def test_other_college_ids_are_404(self):
        t = self.admin()
        sid = self.other_student.id
        self.assertEqual(self.call("post", f"admin/people/{sid}", {"active": False, "reason": "test"}, token=t)[0], 404)
        self.assertTrue(User.objects.get(id=sid).is_active)
        teacher = User.objects.get(phone_number=A_TEACHER)
        status, _ = self.call("post", "admin/assignments", {"teacherId": str(teacher.id),
                                                            "classId": str(self.other_class.id), "subject": "chem11"}, token=t)
        self.assertEqual(status, 404)

    # 3: other roles are refused
    def test_admin_endpoints_refuse_other_roles(self):
        for phone in (ALI, A_TEACHER, ALI_PARENT):
            t = self.login(phone)
            for url in ("admin/overview", "admin/people?role=student", "admin/classes", "admin/audit"):
                self.assertEqual(self.call("get", url, token=t)[0], 403, (phone, url))

    def add_teacher(self, t, phone="03991119001"):
        return self.call("post", "admin/people", {"role": "teacher", "name": "Ms. New Teacher", "phone": phone,
                                                  "gender": "female"}, token=t)

    # 4: a newly added teacher can sign in and sees only their classes
    def test_new_teacher_signs_in_and_sees_assigned_class(self):
        t = self.admin()
        status, teacher = self.add_teacher(t)
        self.assertEqual(status, 200)
        tt = self.login("+923991119001")
        self.assertEqual(self.call("get", "teacher/assignments", token=tt)[1], [])
        status, _ = self.call("post", "admin/assignments", {"teacherId": teacher["id"], "classId": self.my_class_id(t),
                                                            "subject": "eng11"}, token=t)
        self.assertEqual(status, 200)
        _, rows = self.call("get", "teacher/assignments", token=tt)
        self.assertEqual([(r["class"], r["subject"]) for r in rows], [("11th Pre-Medical A", "English")])

    # 5: suspend and reactivate
    def test_suspend_and_reactivate(self):
        t = self.admin()
        ali = User.objects.get(phone_number=ALI)
        self.assertEqual(self.call("post", f"admin/people/{ali.id}", {"active": False}, token=t)[0], 400)  # reason needed
        self.assertEqual(self.call("post", f"admin/people/{ali.id}", {"active": False, "reason": "Left college"}, token=t)[0], 200)
        self.assertEqual(self.call("post", "auth/otp", {"phone": ALI})[1]["error"], "suspended")
        self.call("post", f"admin/people/{ali.id}", {"active": True}, token=t)
        self.assertEqual(self.call("post", "auth/otp", {"phone": ALI})[0], 200)

    # 6: phone numbers are unique across all accounts
    def test_duplicate_phone_is_409(self):
        t = self.admin()
        self.assertEqual(self.add_teacher(t, phone=ALI_PARENT)[0], 409)
        self.assertEqual(self.add_teacher(t, phone="+923992229902")[0], 409)  # another college's student

    def import_csv(self, t, csv, kind="students"):
        return self.call("post", "admin/imports", {"kind": kind, "csv": csv}, token=t)

    # 7: the check reports each bad row, and a file with errors cannot be committed
    def test_import_reports_errors_and_blocks_commit(self):
        t = self.admin()
        bad = STUDENT_CSV + "11th,Pre-Medical,A,11A-01,Dup Roll,male,03992221023,Mr. X,03993331023\n" \
                            "12th,Arts,Q,1,No Class,male,03992221024,Mr. Y,03993331024\n" \
                            "11th,Pre-Medical,A,11A-25,Bad Phone,male,12345,Mr. Z,03993331025\n"
        status, report = self.import_csv(t, bad)
        self.assertEqual(status, 200)
        errors = {e["row"]: e["message"] for e in report["errors"]}
        self.assertEqual(sorted(errors), [4, 5, 6])
        self.assertIn("roll", errors[4].lower())
        self.assertIn("class", errors[5].lower())
        self.assertIn("phone", errors[6].lower())
        self.assertEqual(self.call("post", f"admin/imports/{report['id']}/commit", token=t)[0], 409)
        self.assertFalse(User.objects.filter(full_name="Imran Ali").exists())

    # 8, 9: a clean file commits once; a parent with two children is created once
    def test_import_commits_once(self):
        t = self.admin()
        _, report = self.import_csv(t, STUDENT_CSV)
        self.assertEqual((report["errors"], report["counts"]["rows"]), ([], 2))
        status, done = self.call("post", f"admin/imports/{report['id']}/commit", token=t)
        self.assertEqual((status, done["created"]["students"], done["created"]["parents"]), (200, 2, 1))
        parent = User.objects.get(phone_number="+923993331021")
        self.assertEqual(sorted(c.user.full_name for c in parent.children.all()), ["Faisal Ali", "Imran Ali"])
        self.assertEqual(self.call("post", f"admin/imports/{report['id']}/commit", token=t)[0], 409)
        _, other_report = self.import_csv(self.login(OTHER_ADMIN), STUDENT_CSV.replace("Pre-Medical,A", "Pre-Medical,Z")
                                          .replace("0399222102", "0399222202").replace("0399333102", "0399333202"))
        self.assertEqual(self.call("post", f"admin/imports/{other_report['id']}/commit", token=t)[0], 404)

    def test_teacher_import(self):
        t = self.admin()
        csv = ("teacher_name,teacher_phone,teacher_gender,subject,class_grade,class_stream,class_section\n"
               "Ms. Hira Saleem,03991119002,female,English,11th,Pre-Medical,A\n"
               "Ms. Hira Saleem,03991119002,female,cs11,11th,Pre-Engineering,B\n")
        _, report = self.import_csv(t, csv, kind="teachers")
        self.assertEqual(report["errors"], [])
        self.call("post", f"admin/imports/{report['id']}/commit", token=t)
        tt = self.login("+923991119002")
        _, rows = self.call("get", "teacher/assignments", token=tt)
        self.assertEqual(sorted(r["subject"] for r in rows), ["Computer Science", "English"])

    # 10: every change is in the audit log, with masked phone numbers
    def test_audit_log_masks_phones(self):
        from .models import AuditLog
        t = self.admin()
        self.add_teacher(t)
        _, report = self.import_csv(t, STUDENT_CSV)
        self.call("post", f"admin/imports/{report['id']}/commit", token=t)
        _, rows = self.call("get", "admin/audit", token=t)
        actions = [r["action"] for r in rows]
        self.assertIn("person.add", actions)

If the phone can't connect, allow Python through Windows Firewall on private networks.
- Every start resets the demo to a clean roster. To keep the data from a previous run, use
  `start-demo.bat --keep`.
- The admin panel is at **http://localhost:8000/admin**: phone `+923999990000`, password
  `demo-admin-2026`. Here the college manages classes, students, parents and teacher assignments.

Requires Python 3.11 or later. The start script installs Django.

## Who can sign in

The demo college is **Margalla Heights College (Demo)**, a fictional college. All numbers are in the
`+92 399` range, which no operator issues. Any number not in this list is refused with *"This number is
not registered with any college."*

| Role | Name | Mobile (type the 10 digits after +92) | Linked to |
|---|---|---|---|
| Teacher | Mr. Tariq Mehmood | 399 1110001 | teaches Physics to 11th Pre-Medical A |
| Teacher | Mr. Adeel Anwar | 399 1110003 | teaches Chemistry and Biology to 11th Pre-Medical A (no lessons yet, so "Coming soon") |
| Teacher | Mr. Kamran Shah | 399 1110002 | teaches Physics and Mathematics to 11th Pre-Engineering B |
| Student | Ali Raza | 399 2220001 | 11th Pre-Medical A, roll 11A-01 |

file.content:
gateway in `backend/lms/notify.py`. WhatsApp messages also need pre-approved templates.
- **OTP delivery:** the sign-in code is shown on screen in demo mode. Set `DEMO_MODE=0` and add an SMS
  gateway in `backend/lms/auth.py` to send it for real. `DEMO_MODE=0` also removes the demo accounts list.
- **Infrastructure:** SQLite and Django's development server. For a pilot, use PostgreSQL, a production
  web server with HTTPS, a secret key from the environment, and Cloudflare R2 or a CDN for media.
- **Admin scope:** the admin panel shows everything to the demo admin. A real college admin must be
  limited to their own college.
- **Offline:** there is no offline mode yet (service worker and saved lessons).
- **Data protection:** phone numbers are stored in plain text. Change register item CR-18 covers
  encrypting them.
- **Content:** the lessons are drafts until a physics teacher approves them (`factory.py review`).
  Textbook pages are National Book Foundation material, so keep the demo internal until you have
  permission (CR-02).

"""Serve the web app from ../demo, with HTTP Range support so audio seeking works."""
import mimetypes
import os
import re
from pathlib import Path

from django.conf import settings
from django.http import FileResponse, Http404, HttpResponse

mimetypes.add_type("image/webp", ".webp")
mimetypes.add_type("audio/mpeg", ".mp3")
mimetypes.add_type("application/manifest+json", ".webmanifest")
RANGE_RE = re.compile(r"bytes=(\d*)-(\d*)")


def serve(request, path):
    root = Path(settings.FRONTEND_DIR).resolve()
    target = (root / (path or "index.html")).resolve()
    if root not in target.parents and target != root:
        raise Http404
    if target.is_dir():
        target = target / "index.html"
    if not target.is_file():
        if "." in Path(path).name:
            raise Http404
        target = root / "index.html"  # client-side routes fall back to the app shell
    size = target.stat().st_size
    ctype = mimetypes.guess_type(str(target))[0] or "application/octet-stream"
    match = RANGE_RE.fullmatch(request.headers.get("Range", "").strip())
    if match and (match.group(1) or match.group(2)):
        start, end = match.group(1), match.group(2)
        if start:
            start, end = int(start), min(int(end) if end else size - 1, size - 1)
        else:  # suffix range: last N bytes
            start, end = max(0, size - int(end)), size - 1
        if start > end or start >= size:
            resp = HttpResponse(status=416)
            resp["Content-Range"] = f"bytes */{size}"
            return resp
        with open(target, "rb") as f:
            f.seek(start)
            data = f.read(end - start + 1)
        resp = HttpResponse(data, status=206, content_type=ctype)
        resp["Content-Range"] = f"bytes {start}-{end}/{size}"
    else:
        resp = FileResponse(open(target, "rb"), content_type=ctype)
        resp["Content-Length"] = str(size)
    resp["Accept-Ranges"] = "bytes"
    # App code is revalidated on every load; media is immutable per build.
    resp["Cache-Control"] = "public, max-age=86400" if "/media/" in f"/{path}" else "no-cache"
    return resp

# F3: Parent alerts on free channels

Status: Signed off 2026-10-01 (instruction "continue with the whole development") · Owner: Muhammad Noor Khan · Last updated: 2026-10-01

Roadmap: F3, redesigned by decision D6 (free methods only) · Related: F21 weekly summary, which uses the same channels

## Problem

The demo sends absence and clearance alerts by simulated WhatsApp with SMS fallback. Both cost money per message in real life (from 1 October 2026 Meta charges for every alert-type WhatsApp message), and D6 says free methods only for now. Parents still need to hear about an absence the same day, and the teacher needs to know who has been told.

## Users and access rules

| Role | What they can do | What they must never see or do |
|---|---|---|
| Parent | Turn on alerts on their phone (web push); read every alert in Messages | Alerts about other children |
| Teacher | Turn on alerts on their phone; after attendance, send each absent student's parent a ready-made WhatsApp message with one tap from their own WhatsApp; see who has not been told yet | Links or messages for students outside their classes |
| Student, college admin | No change | — |

A push subscription belongs to the signed-in user only. Alerts are pushed only to that user's own devices.

## Screens

- **Parent home and teacher "My classes":** an **Alerts on this phone** card, with these states:
  - **Off:** a *Turn on alerts* button.
  - **On:** *Alerts are on for this phone* and a Turn off link.
  - **Blocked:** how to allow notifications in the browser settings.
  - **Not supported:** on iPhone, "Add EduSaas to your Home Screen first"; otherwise "Open in Chrome".
- **Teacher class page, after attendance:**
  - A **Tell parents on WhatsApp** list shows each parent of a student marked absent today who hasn't been told yet, with a **Send on WhatsApp** button.
  - The button opens WhatsApp with the parent's number and the message filled in, and marks the parent as told.
  - A badge reads "2 parents not told yet" until all are sent.
- **Messages and the teacher's alerts log:** show each alert with how it was delivered: *In app*, *In app · sent to 1 phone*, or *WhatsApp (sent by the teacher)*.
- **Phone and desktop** use the existing layouts. Push works on Android Chrome and desktop browsers, and on iPhone only after "Add to Home Screen" (iOS 16.4 and later).

## API and data changes

| Method and path | Who | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `GET /api/push/key` | Any signed-in user | The server's public VAPID key |
| `POST /api/push/subscribe` | Any signed-in user | Save this browser's push subscription for the caller |
| `POST /api/push/unsubscribe` | Any signed-in user | Remove it (only the caller's own) |
| `GET /api/teacher/assignments/<id>` (changed) | Teacher | Each pending clearance from today carries `whatsapp: {phone, text, notifiedAt}` |
| `POST /api/teacher/clearances/<id>/whatsapp-sent` | Teacher of that class | Record that the parent was told by WhatsApp |

Model and migration changes:
- **New `PushSubscription`:** user, endpoint (unique), keys, user agent, created time.
- **`Clearance.parent_notified_at`:** set when the teacher taps *Send on WhatsApp*.
- **`Notification.channel`** adds `push`.
- **New setting `PAID_MESSAGING`,** default off (D6):
  - **Off:** every alert goes to the recipient's in-app inbox and is pushed to their devices. No WhatsApp or SMS gateway is called.
  - **On:** the previous WhatsApp-then-SMS chain is used, simulated in demo mode; this keeps the upgrade path.
- **VAPID keys:** read from `VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY` and `VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY`, or generated once into `backend/vapid.json`. That file is a secret and must not be shared.
- **New `demo/sw.js`** (service worker: shows the notification, and opens the app on tap) and a small `manifest.webmanifest` so the app can be added to the Home Screen.

## Acceptance criteria

1. Given free messaging, when a student is marked absent, then the parent gets one inbox alert, it is pushed to each of the parent's subscribed devices, and no WhatsApp or SMS provider is called.
2. Given a push endpoint that answers 404 or 410 (expired), when an alert is sent, then that subscription is deleted, and the inbox alert is still delivered.
3. Given a user with no subscriptions, when an alert is sent, then the inbox alert is delivered and shown as "In app".
4. Given a signed-in user, when they subscribe, then the subscription is saved for them only. Subscribing the same endpoint again updates it rather than duplicating it. Unsubscribing removes only their own.
5. Given a teacher's class with a student marked absent today, then the class response gives the parent's WhatsApp link text and number. Given another teacher, then marking it sent returns 404.
6. Given the teacher marks it sent, then `notifiedAt` is set and the parent drops out of the "not told yet" count.
7. Given `PAID_MESSAGING` on, then the old WhatsApp-then-SMS behaviour and the daily limit still work (existing tests).
8. No phone number or push endpoint appears in the logs.

## Out of scope

- Real WhatsApp Business API or SMS gateway (paid; `PAID_MESSAGING` keeps the path open).
- Free sign-in codes (activation code and PIN, F2).
- Push on phones that open the demo over plain `http://` on the Wi-Fi. Browsers only allow push on HTTPS or `localhost`; this works once the app is hosted with HTTPS (F6).
- Offline lessons (F4).

## Risks and open questions

- **Fewer parents reached automatically.** Parents who never install the app only get the teacher's WhatsApp message. Mitigation: the "not told yet" count, and onboarding at the parent-teacher meeting.
- **iPhone:** push needs the app added to the Home Screen first; the card explains this.

## Definition of done

- [ ] Spec signed off, with out-of-scope items listed
- [ ] Every acceptance criterion has a passing automated test
- [ ] Access-rule tests pass: wrong role, wrong college, wrong class, not linked
- [ ] Screens checked at 360, 390, 768, 1024 and 1440 px in light and dark mode
- [ ] Accessibility checks pass, with no serious or critical issues
- [ ] Performance budget met on the low-end phone profile
- [ ] Works offline or fails with a clear message (no blank screens)
- [ ] English and Urdu text reviewed by a native speaker
- [ ] Content approved by a subject teacher (if students see it)
- [ ] Errors are logged; personal data is not written to the logs
- [ ] README or admin guide updated
- [ ] Tried by at least 2 real users; their issues fixed or logged

## Release report

Filled in one week after release.

Parents still need to hear about an absence the same day, and the teacher needs to know who has been told.

## Users and access rules

| Role | What they can do | What they must never see or do |
|---|---|---|
| Parent | Turn on alerts on their phone (web push); read every alert in Messages | Alerts about other children |
| Teacher | Turn on alerts on their phone; after attendance, send each absent student's parent a ready-made WhatsApp message with one tap from their own WhatsApp; see who has not been told yet | Links or messages for students outside their classes |
| Student, college admin | No change | — |

A push subscription belongs to the signed-in user only. Alerts are pushed only to that user's own devices.

## Screens

- **Parent home and teacher "My classes":** an **Alerts on this phone** card, with these states:
  - **Off:** a *Turn on alerts* button.
  - **On:** *Alerts are on for this phone* and a Turn off link.
  - **Blocked:** how to allow notifications in the browser settings.
  - **Not supported:** on iPhone, "Add EduSaas to your Home Screen first"; otherwise "Open in Chrome".
- **Teacher class page, after attendance:**
  - A **Tell parents on WhatsApp** list shows each parent of a student marked absent today who hasn't been told yet, with a **Send on WhatsApp** button.
  - The button opens WhatsApp with the parent's number and the message filled in, and marks the parent as told.
  - A badge reads "2 parents not told yet" until all are sent.
- **Messages and the teacher's alerts log:** show each alert with how it was delivered: *In app*, *In app · sent to 1 phone*, or *WhatsApp (sent by the teacher)*.
- **Phone and desktop** use the existing layouts. Push works on Android Chrome and desktop browsers, and on iPhone only after "Add to Home Screen" (iOS 16.4 and later).

## API and data changes

| Method and path | Who | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `GET /api/push/key` | Any signed-in user | The server's public VAPID key |
| `POST /api/push/subscribe` | Any signed-in user | Save this browser's push subscription for the caller |
| `POST /api/push/unsubscribe` | Any signed-in user | Remove it (only the caller's own) |
| `GET /api/teacher/assignments/<id>` (changed) | Teacher | Each pending clearance from today carries `whatsapp: {phone, text, notifiedAt}` |
| `POST /api/teacher/clearances/<id>/whatsapp-sent` | Teacher of that class | Record that the parent was told by WhatsApp |

Model and migration changes:
- **New `PushSubscription`:** user, endpoint (unique), keys, user agent, created time.
- **`Clearance.parent_notified_at`:** set when the teacher taps *Send on WhatsApp*.
- **`Notification.channel`** adds `push`.
- **New setting `PAID_MESSAGING`,** default off (D6):
  - **Off:** every alert goes to the recipient's in-app inbox and is pushed to their devices. No WhatsApp or SMS gateway is called.
  - **On:** the previous WhatsApp-then-SMS chain is used, simulated in demo mode; this keeps the upgrade path.
- **VAPID keys:** read from `VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY` and `VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY`, or generated once into `backend/vapid.json`. That file is a secret and must not be shared.
- **New `demo/sw.js`** (service worker: shows the notification, and opens the app on tap) and a small `manifest.webmanifest` so the app can be added to the Home Screen.

## Acceptance criteria

1. Given free messaging, when a student is marked absent, then the parent gets one inbox alert, it is pushed to each of the parent's subscribed devices, and no WhatsApp or SMS provider is called.
2. Given a push endpoint that answers 404 or 410 (expired), when an alert is sent, then that subscription is deleted, and the inbox alert is still delivered.
3. Given a user with no subscriptions, when an alert is sent, then the inbox alert is delivered and shown as "In app".
4. Given a signed-in user, when they subscribe, then the subscription is saved for them only. Subscribing the same endpoint again updates it rather than duplicating it. Unsubscribing removes only their own.
5. Given a teacher's class with a student marked absent today, then the class response gives the parent's WhatsApp link text and number. Given another teacher, then marking it sent returns 404.
6. Given the teacher marks it sent, then `notifiedAt` is set and the parent drops out of the "not told yet" count.
7. Given `PAID_MESSAGING` on, then the old WhatsApp-then-SMS behaviour and the daily limit still work (existing tests).
8. No phone number or push endpoint appears in the logs.

## Out of scope

- Real WhatsApp Business API or SMS gateway (paid; `PAID_MESSAGING` keeps the path open).
- Free sign-in codes (activation code and PIN, F2).
- Push on phones that open the demo over plain `http://` on the Wi-Fi. Browsers only allow push on HTTPS or `localhost`; this works once the app is hosted with HTTPS (F6).
- Offline lessons (F4).

## Risks and open questions

- **Fewer parents reached automatically.** Parents who never install the app only get the teacher's WhatsApp message. Mitigation: the "not told yet" count, and onboarding at the parent-teacher meeting.
- **iPhone:** push needs the app added to the Home Screen first; the card explains this.

## Definition of done

- [ ] Spec signed off, with out-of-scope items listed
- [ ] Every acceptance criterion has a passing automated test
- [ ] Access-rule tests pass: wrong role, wrong college, wrong class, not linked
- [ ] Screens checked at 360, 390, 768, 1024 and 1440 px in light and dark mode
- [ ] Accessibility checks pass, with no serious or critical issues
- [ ] Performance budget met on the low-end phone profile
- [ ] Works offline or fails with a clear message (no blank screens)
- [ ] English and Urdu text reviewed by a native speaker
- [ ] Content approved by a subject teacher (if students see it)
- [ ] Errors are logged; personal data is not written to the logs
- [ ] README or admin guide updated
- [ ] Tried by at least 2 real users; their issues fixed or logged

## Release report

Filled in one week after release.

"""Free web push alerts (F3, decision D6).

Keys: VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY (PEM) and VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY in the environment, or generated once into
backend/vapid.json. That file is a secret: don't share it or put it in the repository.
Browsers only allow push on HTTPS or http://localhost.
"""
import base64
import json
import logging
import os
from pathlib import Path

from django.conf import settings

log = logging.getLogger("lms")
_KEYS = None


def _keys():
    """Return (Vapid01 private key, public key as base64url) and cache them."""
    global _KEYS
    if _KEYS:
        return _KEYS
    from cryptography.hazmat.primitives import serialization
    from py_vapid import Vapid01
    pem = os.environ.get("VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY")
    path = Path(settings.BASE_DIR) / "vapid.json"
    if pem:
        vapid = Vapid01.from_pem(pem.encode())
    elif path.exists():
        vapid = Vapid01.from_pem(json.loads(path.read_text())["private_pem"].encode())
    else:
        vapid = Vapid01()
        vapid.generate_keys()
        path.write_text(json.dumps({"private_pem": vapid.private_pem().decode()}))
    raw = vapid.public_key.public_bytes(serialization.Encoding.X962, serialization.PublicFormat.UncompressedPoint)
    _KEYS = (vapid, base64.urlsafe_b64encode(raw).rstrip(b"=").decode())
    return _KEYS


def public_key():
    return _keys()[1]


def webpush(**kwargs):  # indirection so tests can replace the network call
    from pywebpush import webpush as _webpush
    return _webpush(**kwargs)


def send(user, title, body, url="/"):
    """Push one alert to every browser the user subscribed. Returns (delivered, total). Never raises."""
    subs = list(user.push_subscriptions.all())
    if not subs:
        return 0, 0
    from pywebpush import WebPushException
    vapid = _keys()[0]
    payload = json.dumps({"title": title, "body": body[:400], "url": url})
    ok = 0
    for s in subs:
        try:
            webpush(subscription_info={"endpoint": s.endpoint, "keys": {"p256dh": s.p256dh, "auth": s.auth}},
                    data=payload, vapid_private_key=vapid, vapid_claims={"sub": settings.VAPID_SUBJECT},
                    ttl=86400, timeout=10)
            ok += 1
        except WebPushException as e:
            code = getattr(e.response, "status_code", None)
            if code in (404, 410):  # the browser dropped this subscription
                s.delete()
            log.warning("push to subscription %s failed with status %s", s.id, code)
        except Exception as e:  # network trouble must never break attendance or quizzes
            log.warning("push to subscription %s failed: %s", s.id, type(e).__name__)
    return ok, len(subs)

"""Free web push alerts (F3, decision D6).

Keys: VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY (PEM) and VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY in the environment, or generated once into
backend/vapid.json. That file is a secret: don't share it or put it in the repository.
Browsers only allow push on HTTPS or http://localhost.
"""
import base64
import json
import logging
import os
from pathlib import Path

from django.conf import settings

log = logging.getLogger("lms")
_KEYS = None


def _keys():
    """Return (Vapid01 private key, public key as base64url) and cache them."""
    global _KEYS
    if _KEYS:
        return _KEYS
    from cryptography.hazmat.primitives import serialization
    from py_vapid import Vapid01
    pem = os.environ.get("VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY")
    path = Path(settings.BASE_DIR) / "vapid.json"
    if pem:
        vapid = Vapid01.from_pem(pem.encode())
    elif path.exists():
        vapid = Vapid01.from_pem(json.loads(path.read_text())["private_pem"].encode())
    else:
        vapid = Vapid01()
        vapid.generate_keys()
        path.write_text(json.dumps({"private_pem": vapid.private_pem().decode()}))
    raw = vapid.public_key.public_bytes(serialization.Encoding.X962, serialization.PublicFormat.UncompressedPoint)
    _KEYS = (vapid, base64.urlsafe_b64encode(raw).rstrip(b"=").decode())
    return _KEYS


def public_key():
    return _keys()[1]


def webpush(**kwargs):  # indirection so tests can replace the network call
    from pywebpush import webpush as _webpush
    return _webpush(**kwargs)


def send(user, title, body, url="/"):
    """Push one alert to every browser the user subscribed. Returns (delivered, total). Never raises."""
    subs = list(user.push_subscriptions.all())
    if not subs:
        return 0, 0
    from pywebpush import WebPushException
    vapid = _keys()[0]
    payload = json.dumps({"title": title, "body": body[:400], "url": url})
    ok = 0
    for s in subs:
        try:
            webpush(subscription_info={"endpoint": s.endpoint, "keys": {"p256dh": s.p256dh, "auth": s.auth}},
                    data=payload, vapid_private_key=vapid, vapid_claims={"sub": settings.VAPID_SUBJECT},
                    ttl=86400, timeout=10)
            ok += 1
        except WebPushException as e:
            code = getattr(e.response, "status_code", None)
            if code in (404, 410):  # the browser dropped this subscription
                s.delete()
            log.warning("push to subscription %s failed with status %s", s.id, code)
        except Exception as e:  # network trouble must never break attendance or quizzes
            log.warning("push to subscription %s failed: %s", s.id, type(e).__name__)
    return ok, len(subs)

# F23: Urdu interface and alert language

Status: Signed off 2026-10-01 (instruction "continue with the whole development") · Owner: Muhammad Noor Khan · Last updated: 2026-10-01

Plan: [implementation plan, F12 and F23](../implementation-plan-subjects-languages-admin-parent.md#f12-and-f23-urdu) · Related: F12 (Urdu narration)

## Problem

Many parents, and some students, read Urdu far more easily than English. Today every screen and every alert is in English, so a parent may not understand an absence alert or their child's progress.

## Users and access rules

| Role | What changes | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Student | Can switch the app to Urdu (اردو) | Lesson titles, the textbook page and physics terms stay as in the book |
| Parent | Can switch the app to Urdu; alerts and the weekly summary arrive in the parent's chosen language | The language is saved to the parent's account, so alerts use it even when the app is closed |
| Teacher, college admin | Can switch, but their screens stay in English in this release | Out of scope below |

Users can only change their own language.

## Screens

- **Header:** a language button showing **اردو** (or **English** when Urdu is on). It switches at once, without a reload.
- **Urdu mode:**
  - The page reads right to left (`dir="rtl"`), in a Nastaliq font with taller line spacing.
  - Numbers, phone numbers, physics formulas, units (m/s², kg) and the textbook page stay left to right.
  - Dates use Urdu month and day names.
- **Screens translated in this release:**
  - sign-in
  - bottom navigation
  - student home, subject page, library, lesson player and quiz, including result and review
  - parent home, child subject detail, Messages
  - the alerts card, offline and error cards, and common toasts
- **Before signing in:** the choice is remembered on the device (so the sign-in screen can be Urdu). After signing in it is also saved to the account.

## API and data changes

| Method and path | Who | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `POST /api/me/language` | Any signed-in user | `{language: "en" or "ur"}`; saves it to the caller's account |
| `GET /api/me` (changed) | Any signed-in user | Includes `language` |

Model and migration changes:
- **`User.language`:** `en` or `ur`, default `en`.
- **Urdu alert texts:** absence alert, cleared by quiz, cleared by teacher and the weekly summary each have an Urdu version in `notify.py`. The parent's language decides which is sent (inbox, push and the teacher's WhatsApp link).
- **Teacher alerts** stay in English.

## Acceptance criteria

1. Given a parent who chose Urdu, when their child is marked absent, then the inbox alert, the push text and the teacher's WhatsApp link text are in Urdu.
2. Given a parent who chose English (the default), then alerts stay in English.
3. Given any user, when they post `language: "fr"`, then the server returns 400. A user can only change their own language.
4. Given Urdu is on, then the student and parent screens in scope show no untranslated English labels (checked by a browser test listing every visible label), and the layout is right to left with no text overflowing at 360 px.
5. Given the weekly summary for an Urdu parent, then it is written in Urdu.

## Out of scope

- Teacher and college admin screens in Urdu (a later release).
- Translating lesson titles, textbook pages or quiz questions (content; F12 adds Urdu narration).
- Roman Urdu as an interface language.

## Risks and open questions

- **The Urdu text must be reviewed by a native speaker** before parents see it. The first version was written during development, so it is a draft.
- **Fonts:** some Android phones have no Nastaliq font. The app falls back to Naskh-style Arabic script, which is readable, and loads Noto Nastaliq Urdu from Google Fonts only when Urdu is on, to save data.

## Definition of done

- [ ] Spec signed off, with out-of-scope items listed
- [ ] Every acceptance criterion has a passing automated test
- [ ] Access-rule tests pass: wrong role, wrong college, wrong class, not linked
- [ ] Screens checked at 360, 390, 768, 1024 and 1440 px in light and dark mode
- [ ] Accessibility checks pass, with no serious or critical issues
- [ ] Performance budget met on the low-end phone profile
- [ ] Works offline or fails with a clear message (no blank screens)
- [ ] English and Urdu text reviewed by a native speaker
- [ ] Content approved by a subject teacher (if students see it)
- [ ] Errors are logged; personal data is not written to the logs
- [ ] README or admin guide updated
- [ ] Tried by at least 2 real users; their issues fixed or logged

## Release report

Filled in one week after release.

"""Run the stages for each lesson and bundle the result into a Lesson Object (lesson.json).

Output layout (per book):
  output/<book>/pages/p<N>.webp
  output/<book>/lessons/<lesson-id>/script.json    validated script + quiz, with its input key
  output/<book>/lessons/<lesson-id>/sections/*.mp3 per-section narration cache
  output/<book>/lessons/<lesson-id>/audio.mp3      the full lecture
  output/<book>/lessons/<lesson-id>/lesson.json    the Lesson Object

Every stage is idempotent: re-running with unchanged inputs changes nothing on disk.
"""
import datetime as dt
import math
import shutil
from pathlib import Path

from . import tts
from .pages import render_pages
from .schema import validate_script
from .util import log, read_json, sha, write_json

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent


def now():
    return dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc).replace(microsecond=0).isoformat()


def load_book(book_id):
    path = ROOT / "books" / f"{book_id}.json"
    if not path.exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"no book config at {path}")
    book = read_json(path)
    book["pdf_path"] = (path.parent / book["pdf"]).resolve()
    book["out"] = ROOT / "output" / book["id"]
    return book


def all_lessons(book):
    for unit in book["units"]:
        for lesson in unit["lessons"]:
            yield unit, lesson


def pick(book, ids=None):

    ldir = out / "lessons" / lesson["id"]

    # 1. Pages
    page_files = render_pages(book["pdf_path"], lesson["pages"], out / "pages",
                              offset=book.get("pdf_page_offset", 0), force=force)

    # 2. Script + quiz (skipped when the inputs have not changed)
    key = source.input_key(lesson, page_files)
    cached = read_json(ldir / "script.json")
    if cached and cached["key"] == key and not force:
        script, meta = cached["script"], cached["meta"]
        log.info("  script: unchanged, reusing")
    else:

    audio = ldir / "audio.mp3"

    previous = read_json(ldir / "lesson.json", {})
    review = previous.get("review") if previous.get("generated", {}).get("script_key") == key else None
    review = review or {"status": "draft", "reviewed_by": None, "reviewed_at": None, "comment": None}
    obj = {
        "id": lesson["id"],
        "book": book["id"],
        "subject": book["subject"],
        "grade": book["grade"],
        "unit": {"number": unit["number"], "title": unit["title"]},

        "review": review,
        "generated": {"source": source.name, "meta": meta, "voice": voice, "rate": rate, "script_key": key},
    }
    body = {k: v for k, v in obj.items() if k != "generated"}
    old_body = {k: v for k, v in previous.items() if k != "generated"}

        obj["generated"]["at"] = now()
        write_json(ldir / "lesson.json", obj)

# F12: Urdu narration option

Status: Built 2026-10-01 (signed off the same day under the instruction "continue with the whole development"); the Urdu narration awaits teacher review · Owner: Muhammad Noor Khan · Last updated: 2026-10-01

Plan: [implementation plan, F12](../implementation-plan-subjects-languages-admin-parent.md#f12-urdu-narration-track) · Decisions: D5 (English mix by default, Urdu option), plan decision 6 (the subject teacher reviews the Urdu)

## Problem

Lessons are narrated in Roman Urdu mixed with English, read by an Indian-English voice. Students who think in Urdu find the accent and the English terms hard to follow. They need the same lesson narrated in proper Urdu by a Pakistani voice, without losing the textbook page alongside.

## Users and access rules

| Role | What they can do | What they must never see or do |
|---|---|---|
| Student | Switch the lesson between **English mix** and **اردو**; hearing 90% of either track unlocks the quiz | An Urdu track that a teacher has not approved (outside demo mode) |
| Subject teacher | Approve or request changes to the Urdu narration separately from the lesson | — |
| Parent, college admin | No change | — |

## Screens

- **Lesson player:** a **Narration: English mix | اردو** switch above the caption, shown only when the lesson has an Urdu track.
  - Switching changes the audio, the "Now explaining" caption and the full transcript (Nastaliq, right to left).
  - It keeps the textbook page and the quiz rule.
  - The choice is remembered on the device.
- **Media controls and the progress bar** stay left to right.
- **Desktop:** the switch sits at the top of the side column.

## API and data changes

| Method and path | Who | Change |
|---|---|---|
| `GET /api/lessons/<id>` | Student | Adds `urdu: {audio, duration, review, script}` when the Urdu track may be shown, else `null` |
| `POST /api/lessons/<id>/progress` | Student | Accepts `track: "mix"` or `"ur"`; heard seconds are kept per track; 90% of either unlocks the quiz |

- **Content Factory:**
  - Authored scripts take an optional `sections_ur` (same page order as `sections`).
  - `build` narrates it with `ur-PK-AsadNeural` (`voice_ur` in the book config) into `audio-ur.mp3`, with its own cue times.
  - `lesson.json` gets `tracks.ur` and a separate `review_ur`.
  - Review it with `python factory.py review phy11 <lesson> --approve --track ur --by "<teacher>"`.
- **Backend:**
  - `Lesson` gains `ur_audio`, `ur_audio_bytes`, `ur_duration_sec`, `ur_sections` and `ur_review_status`.
  - `LessonProgress` gains `heard_secs_ur`.
  - `import_lessons` copies the Urdu audio.

## Acceptance criteria

1. Given an authored script with `sections_ur`, when built, then `audio-ur.mp3` is narrated with the Urdu voice, with cue times, and its review starts as draft. Approving it survives an unchanged rebuild and does not approve the main lesson.
2. Given Urdu sections out of page order or on a page outside the lesson, then the build is refused.
3. Given a lesson with an Urdu track, then the lesson response includes it, with Urdu-script sections.
4. Given a student hears 90% of the Urdu track and none of the English mix, then the quiz unlocks.
5. Given an Urdu track still in draft outside demo mode, then it is not offered and its progress is refused. Once approved, it is offered.
6. Given an unknown track name, then the server returns 400.

## Out of scope

- Urdu quiz questions (the quiz stays in the textbook's English).
- Urdu narration for subjects without content.
- A paid voice service. `edge-tts` is free but unofficial; switching to Azure Speech only changes `cf/tts.py:synthesize`.

## Risks and open questions

- **The Urdu script is a first draft written during development.** Technical terms are written phonetically in Urdu script (فورس، ایکسلریشن) so the voice pronounces them reliably. A physics teacher who reads Urdu must check every term and number before it is approved.
- **Pronunciation of formulas** (for example "ایل ٹی کی طاقت منفی دو") needs a listening check by a teacher.

## Definition of done

- [x] Spec signed off, with out-of-scope items listed
- [x] Every acceptance criterion has a passing automated test
- [x] Access-rule tests pass: wrong role, wrong college, wrong class, not linked
- [ ] Screens checked at 360, 390, 768, 1024 and 1440 px in light and dark mode
- [ ] Accessibility checks pass, with no serious or critical issues
- [ ] Performance budget met on the low-end phone profile
- [ ] Works offline or fails with a clear message (no blank screens)
- [ ] English and Urdu text reviewed by a native speaker
- [ ] Content approved by a subject teacher (if students see it)
- [x] Errors are logged; personal data is not written to the logs
- [x] README or admin guide updated
- [ ] Tried by at least 2 real users; their issues fixed or logged

## Implementation notes

Built on 1 October 2026.

- **Content:** all three Unit 1 lessons now have Urdu narration: 1.1 (13 sections, 3:02), 1.2 (10 sections, 1:51) and 1.3 (12 sections, 3:03), about 0.7–1.1 MB each, voice `ur-PK-AsadNeural`. Each lesson's `review_notes` flags the Urdu as a draft.
- **Progress:** the quiz unlocks on 90% of either track. `heardShare` reports the larger of the two, so the home screen and parent view are unchanged.
- **Font:** the Nastaliq font is loaded when the Urdu track is chosen, even if the rest of the app is in English.

Checks run: 19 Content Factory tests (3 new) and 76 backend tests (3 new). Browser journey at 390 px (English and Urdu interface) and 1280 px: switching to Urdu plays the 1:51 Urdu audio with Urdu captions and transcript, the server records Urdu heard time separately (3.6% Urdu, 0% mix after a few seconds), switching back restores the English mix, and there are no page errors.

## Release report

Filled in one week after release.
